summary: Pharming Group N.V. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release dated August 13, 2026, announcing the commercial launch of Joenja (leniolisib) in Japan for patients with APDS aged 4 and older. The launch follows inclusion on Japan's NHI drug price list and MHLW approval in March 2026. OrphanPacific, Inc. serves as Marketing Authorization Holder and handles supply and distribution in Japan. No financial terms, share prices, or strategic transactions are disclosed. This is a routine product launch announcement, not an M&A, capital markets, or special-situation event. No deal terms, board actions, or regulatory transactions beyond product approval and launch are referenced. The filing is informational for investors tracking commercial milestones.
